title: 麻将胡了 Mobile 游戏卡片背景 OpenAI API 对照候选
intendedUse: 手机大厅麻将胡了游戏卡片的静态竖版背景；界面文案由 H5 绘制
prompt: Create an original portrait 9:16 mobile game-card background based on the supplied 麻将胡了 PC portrait art. Preserve its bright warm Chinese lounge, circular window, ivory and jade mahjong tiles and golden light, but recompose for a narrow phone card. Several recognizable mahjong tiles float in the air at different depths, gently tumbling around one larger ivory-and-jade focal tile. Use simple traditional engraved tile motifs that remain decorative and do not form malformed readable Chinese characters. Place the floating tile group in the upper-middle, with the lower 20 percent quieter for interface text. Match the PC source's polished dimensional casual-game illustration and warm jade/gold material quality. No text, names, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, people, money or photorealism.
negativePrompt: wide crop, flat tile symbols, malformed Chinese text, tile faces fused together, logos, watermark, UI, people, currency, photorealism, unreadable dark scene, excessive glow, clutter

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match the PC art's warm Chinese lounge, ivory/jade tile material, composition cues and polished 3D rendering; create a new mobile composition.
